title: Spinach Salad with Veggie Sausage, Lentils & Lemon-Dijon Dressing

steps.text: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water and place in a medium saucepan; add broth and bring to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook lentils until tender, about 15 minutes; drain and rinse with cold water (from the tap) to cool. Set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a large bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Place sausages on the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
Add lentils, sausage, and spinach to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
